purpose: decompose a benchmark-style greedy oracle gap (Werner et al. 2023/2024; Huseljic et al. 2026) into test-reuse optimism, aleatoric floor and deployable gap, under the risk envelope, in controlled, semi-synthetic and real-label (credit, diabetes) states
oracle: greedy: add the feasible candidate that most reduces Brier on test half T1 (stop when none improves or K labels); ex-post oracle uses each replicate's realized training labels; ex-ante oracle uses the mean over half of the replicates and is scored on the other half (two-fold cross-fit); downstream learner l2-logistic (0.45)

study.test_split: recorded (real) or drawn-once (known p) test labels, random halves T1/T2 per state
study.note: 19 groups (1 controlled, 8 semi-synthetic, 8 credit real-label, 2 diabetes real-label) x 3 endpoints

inference.method: paired one-sample t on independent units; Bonferroni simultaneous t intervals and global Holm within each registered family

stopping: fixed sizes; no interim looks; no additional seeds after results
